name: sumi
description: UX/UI design mastery plugin — 26 skills, 28 commands across 6 numbered phases (GROUND → DISCOVER → DIAGNOSE → FORTIFY → BUILD → LAUNCH). Each command carries a phase.step address (0.1–5.4) grounded in NNG methodology and visual design process. Phase Position headers guide users through the journey. Dual UX + commercial milestones per phase. Commands: /guide, /ground (0.1), /intent (0.2), /taste (1.1), /inspo (1.2), /benchmark (1.3), /pulse (1.4), /patterns (1.5), /vision (1.6), /vibe-check (2.1), /brain-scan (2.2), /include (2.3), /flow (2.4), /dark-scan (3.1), /trust-scan (3.2), /copy-check (3.3), /responsive (3.4), /drip (4.1), /screen (4.2), /ship (4.3), /onboard (4.4), /extract (4.5), /generate (4.6), /assets (4.7), /roast (5.1), /remix (5.2), /judge (5.3), /visual-score (5.4). Covers NNG design thinking process, heuristics, cognitive psychology, UI pattern intelligence (200+ patterns, 50+ product benchmarks, 100+ anti-patterns), visual design mastery (36+ designers, 70 canonical rules, 10-dimension scoring), platform visual standards (iOS 26 Liquid Glass, M3 Expressive, modern CSS, 9 device types), AI design generation (Stitch MCP, Fal.ai, Recraft V3, Veo 3.1), production code (React/SwiftUI/CSS), Figma MCP, accessibility (WCAG 2.2+3.0), mobile/desktop/web/watch/TV/spatial/automotive, motion, AI/spatial/voice UX, design systems, and 20+ industry verticals.
